notice: All states are authored premises for explaining a filled audit. This is not a test transcript, consumer observation, or instrument qualification.

rows.note: The scenario product produces the correct set of output records.
rows.action: Collect the actual product evidence before accepting this claim.
rows.title: The core operation produces the required result for a representative valid input

rows.note: A valid implementation using a different output filename is rejected despite producing the right records.
rows.action: Qualify filename-independent semantic equivalence against the accepted outcome.
rows.title: The grader accepts a valid solution that differs from its reference implementation

rows.note: The grader still rejects empty/no-op output.
rows.action: Collect the actual product evidence before accepting this claim.

rows.note: Expected records come from the accepted consumer contract rather than copying candidate output.
rows.action: Collect the actual product evidence before accepting this claim.
rows.title: The oracle's expected result has a justification outside the candidate output alone

rows.note: The evaluator scope silently adds a filename constraint absent from the consumer contract.
rows.action: Collect the actual product evidence before accepting this claim.
rows.title: Known grader limitations constrain the claims it may support

rows.note: The corrected evaluator has not yet been versioned and qualified.
rows.action: Collect the actual product evidence before accepting this claim.
rows.title: A grader update has its own version and qualification record

rows.note: Evaluator changes have not yet been applied.
rows.action: Collect the actual product evidence before accepting this claim.
rows.title: Changing a grader creates an attributable evaluator revision

rows.note: The previous report remains preserved; it is not rewritten as a product success.
rows.action: Collect the actual product evidence before accepting this claim.
rows.title: A corrected oracle does not retroactively rewrite the old product verdict

rows.note: Repeated failure fingerprints identify the same incidental filename assertion.
rows.action: Collect the actual product evidence before accepting this claim.
rows.title: A repeated failure signature is retained across sessions

rows.note: Restarting a context is distinguished from correcting the contract.
rows.action: Collect the actual product evidence before accepting this claim.
rows.title: Restart, replay, reseed, replan and contract revision are separately recorded

rows.note: A valid non-identical witness is the next discriminating experiment, not another identical patch.
rows.action: Collect the actual product evidence before accepting this claim.
